name: topsolid_list_projects

name: topsolid_get_object_model
description: Read the TopSolid identifier/name hierarchy and CRUD rules from the Design Automation Guide and 7.20 API contracts. Offline; no TopSolid connection needed.

name: topsolid_inspect_document_identities
description: Resolve exact document revisions to PDM object, major/minor revision IDs and text, name, type GUID and optional universal domain/name. A type GUID is not an object ID. Up to 100 revisions per call; no opening or saving.

items.description: Exact DocumentId returned by a tool.

name: topsolid_set_document_universal_id
description: Set or remove a document's universal (domain,name) identifier. This is not a GUID or display name. Requires confirmation and an undoable document modification; does not save. Use deliberate application/company domain and unique name.

documentId.description: Exact document revision to modify.

remove.description: True to remove the universal identifier; default false.

name: topsolid_resolve_pdm_documents
description: Resolve up to 100 PDM objects to verified backing DocumentIds, keeping both ID kinds, names and document type. Projects/libraries may have metadata documents; do not assume they are modeling documents. Returns null where no document exists. No opening; use explicit minor revisions for historical work.

items.description: PdmObjectId, not DocumentId or type GUID.

name: topsolid_find_pdm_documents
description: Find document candidates by exact PDM name or universal (domain,name). Names can match multiple objects; preserve all candidates and ask for selection when ambiguous. Optional projectId scopes the query. Results include friendly names, owner, type and exact PDM IDs.

name.description: Exact PDM document name or universal name.

domain.description: With name, use universal-identifier lookup instead of display-name search.

projectId.description: Optional working/library project PdmObjectId. Omit to search all projects.

name: topsolid_list_pdm_document_revisions
description: List every major/minor revision relationship of one TopSolid PDM document, with revision text and exact historical DocumentId. IDs remain opaque; do not derive them by editing strings. Does not open or restore revisions.

pdmObjectId.description: TopSolid document PdmObjectId, not a revision ID.

name: topsolid_update_pdm_objects
description: Update names/descriptions of up to 32 exact PDM objects after confirmation. Persistent PDM metadata changes, outside document modification/undo. Reads back each result; returns partial receipts on failure and never retries.

pdmObjectId.description: Exact PDM object selected from live results.

name.description: New PDM name. Names need not be unique.

name: topsolid_delete_pdm_documents
description: Delete up to 32 exact PDM document objects after confirmation. No folders/projects, revision purge or annihilation. This is PDM deletion, not deletion of elements inside a document. Outside document undo; partial outcomes are possible.

name: topsolid_restore_pdm_documents
description: Restore up to 32 deleted PDM document objects by their retained exact IDs after confirmation. This restores deleted objects, not an older document revision. Persistent action outside document undo.

items.description: Exact deleted document PdmObjectId from a prior receipt or live PDM query.

name: topsolid_check_in_pdm_objects
description: CHECK IN exact PDM objects using the native CheckInSeveral API. For an entire working project, pass its PdmObjectId with recursive=true. One confirmation includes all owned constituents, up to 128 targets; never traverses library references. Saving alone is NOT check-in. Reads back actual PDM states; partial/uncertain outcomes are never retried.

items.description: Exact working project, folder or document PdmObjectId.

recursive.description: Include owned descendants. Set true only for an explicitly requested whole project/folder check-in. Default false.

name: topsolid_save_documents
description: Save modified documents in ONE native batch and ONE confirmation. Default scope=openDirty selects modified OPEN documents, including synchronized partners. loadedDirty is available only for an explicit request to save all loaded documents, including dependencies. Alternatively supply exact documentIds. No preliminary document listing is needed. Maximum 128 affected documents; no check-in.

scope.description: Default openDirty. loadedDirty includes loaded dependency documents and must be explicitly requested.

items.description: Exact loaded document revision ID. Mutually exclusive with scope.

name: topsolid_find_named_elements
description: Find all exact internal-name or friendly-name matches in one document revision. Friendly names may be duplicated or translated: ambiguous results require explicit handle selection before changing anything. Scans native elements once, returns named, typed handles; never treats a type GUID as an element ID.

documentId.description: Exact document revision; omit for the currently edited document.

nameKind.description: Default friendlyName. Internal system names use their untranslated $... value.

name: topsolid_inspect_pdm_objects
description: Read friendly names, descriptions, type, state and owner for up to 100 supplied PDM IDs in one call. Continue with nextOffset if needed. One inaccessible object does not discard the other results.

name: topsolid_inspect_elements
description: Read names, types, visibility, validity and deletability for up to 100 exact handles in one request. Per-item failures are explicit. Follow nextOffset when hasMore=true.

documentId.description: Exact document revision ID returned by a tool.

id.description: Element number returned by a tool.

name: topsolid_list_named_elements
description: List document elements with friendly names, types and state together. Prefer this over listing IDs then inspecting each element. Use kind to narrow the query; follow nextOffset until hasMore=false.

documentId.description: Exact document revision; default active.

name: topsolid_list_parameter_values
description: List parameter names, values, types and SI unit metadata together. Avoid one get_parameter_value call per parameter. Follow nextOffset until hasMore=false; unsupported value types are marked.

documentId.description: Document revision; default active.

name: topsolid_list_shape_summaries
description: List shape names, types, face/edge/vertex counts and solid volumes in one page. SI volume is cubic metres. Follow nextOffset; does not call the model for each shape.

documentId.description: Document revision; default active.

name: topsolid_list_assembly_occurrences

documentId.description: Assembly revision; default active.

name: topsolid_list_cam_operation_summaries

documentId.description: CAM document revision; default active.

name: topsolid_create_sketch_profiles
description: Draw up to 32 native primitives in ONE sketch: circles, rectangles, lines, arcs, polylines, cubic B-splines, quadratic parabolas represented as cubic B-splines with checked readback. Open curves remain segments. New explicit placement, associative reference plane/anchor/axes, or append to existing sketch. Reference mode defaults to associative; requires a real anchor vertex and zero normal offset. Shape dimensions remain independent. One confirmation; no save.

documentId.description: Exact target document revision ID returned by a live tool.
Exact document revision ID returned by a tool.

id.description: Element number returned by a tool.

placement.description: New sketch: 2d, a principal 3D plane, explicit frame, or reference sketch. Omit all placement options when appending to sketch.

documentSpace.description: Containing document dimension. Parts contain 2D sketches but documentSpace=3d. Required for frame/reference; recommended when appending.

name.description: Optional name for a new sketch only.

origin.description: Default zero. Principal placement: WORLD origin. Reference placement: offset in reference local X/Y/normal from its origin or anchor. Lengths use input units.

rotationDegrees.description: In-plane rotation from placement/reference X toward Y. Default 0.

documentId.description: Exact document revision ID returned by a tool.

id.description: Element number returned by a tool.

referenceMode.description: Default associative: follow the reference plane, anchor and axes through native Smart objects. Requires anchor, zero normal offset and rotation in multiples of 90 degrees. snapshot only if the user explicitly wants fixed placement. Local dimensions do not automatically copy referenced curve dimensions.

documentId.description: Exact document revision ID returned by a tool.

id.description: Element number returned by a tool.

type.description: Exact label type returned by a topology tool.

id.description: Exact label ID.

location.description: From referenceSketch: vertex; segment start/end; circular center; midParameter (parameter midpoint, not generally half arc length). Resolved by server, never guessed.

sectionMode.description: Default none. Sections are explicit opt-in for closed profiles only.

kind.description: Server-computed primitive. Supply ONLY its fields: circle(origin,radius); rectangle(origin,width,height); polyline(points,closed); line(start,end); arc(start,end,center,clockwise); bspline(controlPoints,periodic); parabola(vertex,focalLength,startParameter,endParameter,rotationDegrees); star(center,outerRadius,innerRadius,pointCount,rotationDegrees); ellipse(center,majorRadius,minorRadius,rotationDegrees,tolerance). Ellipse is a bounded cubic approximation, not an analytic ellipse.

units.description: Optional redundant units; must equal the root units. Prefer units once at the request root.

closed.description: Polyline closure; omit repeated final start point.

clockwise.description: Arc direction in local sketch X/Y.

periodic.description: Uniform cubic B-spline; points are controls, not interpolation points. Omit repeated first control.

focalLength.description: Signed nonzero focal distance f. Before rotation: x=t, y=t^2/(4f), measured from vertex.

startParameter.description: Start x/t in input length units, less than endParameter.

endParameter.description: End x/t in input length units.

outerRadius.description: Star tip radius, larger than innerRadius.

pointCount.description: Number of star tips; generates twice as many line segments.

majorRadius.description: Ellipse semimajor radius along local X before rotation, at least minorRadius.

minorRadius.description: Ellipse semiminor radius along local Y before rotation.

tolerance.description: Required maximum ellipse approximation deviation in input length units, disclosed in preview. Server bounds error and work; not an exact conic.

rotationDegrees.description: Required shape rotation: parabola about vertex (0 opens +Y for positive f); star first tip or ellipse major axis angle from local +X. Ask unless user delegates sample values.

name: topsolid_create_sketches2d
description: Draw several requested 2D sketches in one document with ONE confirmation and ONE undoable transaction. Up to 8 sketches, 32 primitives total, 512 segments/control vertices. Lines/arcs/circles/rectangles/polylines/B-splines/parabolas. Explicit position/rotation or associative reference plane+anchor+axes. Reference mode defaults to associative and requires an actual anchor vertex and quarter-turn rotation; 3D documents support XY offsets and quarter-turn rotation with zero normal offset. Native 2D supports zero offset/quarter turns. Local dimensions are independent; no inferred dimensional constraints. Ask for missing design data. No auto-save.

origin.description: Default zero. Principal placement: WORLD origin. Reference placement: offset in reference local X/Y/normal from its origin or anchor. Lengths use input units.

rotationDegrees.description: In-plane rotation from placement/reference X toward Y. Default 0.

Local dimensions do not automatically copy referenced curve dimensions.

location.description: From referenceSketch: vertex; segment start/end; circular center; midParameter (parameter midpoint, not generally half arc length). Resolved by server, never guessed.

kind.description: Server-computed primitive. Supply ONLY its fields: circle(origin,radius); rectangle(origin,width,height); polyline(points,closed); line(start,end); arc(start,end,center,clockwise); bspline(controlPoints,periodic); parabola(vertex,focalLength,startParameter,endParameter,rotationDegrees); star(center,outerRadius,innerRadius,pointCount,rotationDegrees); ellipse(center,majorRadius,minorRadius,rotationDegrees,tolerance). Ellipse is a bounded cubic approximation, not an analytic ellipse.

units.description: Optional redundant units; must equal the root units. Prefer units once at the request root.

closed.description: Polyline closure; omit repeated final start point.

clockwise.description: Arc direction in local sketch X/Y.

periodic.description: Uniform cubic B-spline; points are controls, not interpolation points. Omit repeated first control.

focalLength.description: Signed nonzero focal distance f. Before rotation: x=t, y=t^2/(4f), measured from vertex.

startParameter.description: Start x/t in input length units, less than endParameter.

endParameter.description: End x/t in input length units.

outerRadius.description: Star tip radius, larger than innerRadius.

pointCount.description: Number of star tips; generates twice as many line segments.

majorRadius.description: Ellipse semimajor radius along local X before rotation, at least minorRadius.

minorRadius.description: Ellipse semiminor radius along local Y before rotation.

tolerance.description: Required maximum ellipse approximation deviation in input length units, disclosed in preview. Server bounds error and work; not an exact conic.

rotationDegrees.description: Required shape rotation: parabola about vertex (0 opens +Y for positive f); star first tip or ellipse major axis angle from local +X. Ask unless user delegates sample values.

units.description: Optional redundant units; must match root units. Prefer root units only.

sectionMode.description: Default none. Opt in only for requested sections/modeling requiring closed profiles.

sketches.description: Each entry has name/placement and REQUIRED profiles:[{kind,...geometry}]. Never put primitive geometry directly on a sketch. Example: {name:'Star_XZ',placement:'xz',profiles:[{kind:'star',center:{x:0,y:0},outerRadius:50,innerRadius:20,pointCount:5,rotationDegrees:90}]}
